title: ASMR Hypnosis Mind Massage (ORIGINAL)
description: "Shh... You don't need to say a word... I'm here for you, okay? You look so down and weary of the world. But now it's time to let all of that go. I'm here, and you're safe with me. Just lay down in my lap, my sweet, and relax awhile. As my gentle suggestions and soft fingertips massage away your mind." * * * There are ways to feel better. There are experiences where you can drift along in comfort and relaxing hypnotic slumber. There are even some hypnotic experiences where you can feel so Deep and Blank that you reach euphoria. And then there are those deeply powerful experiences where you can melt away into nothingness. And if you're so inclined... You can seek them at my touch, and search for them in my voice.
author: Mistress Shibby
